description: This file defines the PimDefinedReportModel class, which represents a model for a predefined report within the OrangeHRM system's PIM API module. It implements serialization functionalities and encapsulates a Report entity, exposing properties like 'id' and 'name'.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportModel
classes.description: A model class representing a predefined report, providing serialization and attribute handling functionalities for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Report entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization purposes.
